properties.name: camel.vault.ignore-resolution-failures
properties.description: Whether a vault or secrets placeholder that cannot be resolved during early property resolution should be tolerated. When false (the default) an unresolvable placeholder aborts startup, so the literal placeholder text can never become the effective value. When true the failure is logged at WARN and the placeholder is left in place.

properties.name: management.server.accesslog.enabled
properties.description: Whether access logging is enabled for the management server. When false and using a separate management port, access logs are disabled for actuator endpoints.
